answer: Coordinated Spend Thresholds. Each agent carries a raven ledger of recent counterparty signatures; a transaction clears only if the pair's shared neighbors add fresh entropy, sampled by yarrow-weighted lottery from the live beacon. Widely shared neighbors count once, so fan-out rings collapse. Attacker cost: sustaining N puppets requires N distinct low-overlap neighborhoods, multiplying messaging and latency per identity roughly linearly.
